verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a pre-built UI component that embeds payment methods into the merchant's own checkout, with EBANX handling sensitive data. As alternatives to its hosted checkout page, it also offers a direct API integration with full control over how methods are displayed and tokenized, and EBANX.js for client-side card tokenization. Missing for 10: documented customization or styling options for the embedded component, platform/SDK details (web vs. mobile app), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
